description: I honestly can't believe I got this opportunity without any prior internship experience. I'm super excited and ready to grind this summer!
Galvanize was my first offer and choice when I was applying for my first internship. They took a chance on me and I'm ready to show them that was the right choice.
Supporting Professors Sabrina Rai, Zorana Svedic, Hasan Cavusoglu, and 120 students in UBC's largest business technology course.
Contributed in preseason inventory, planning, and setup processes. Oversaw nightly operations, ordered inventory, streamlined employee onboarding, and facilitated interviews.
Optimized inventory ordering by 50% (40 to < 20 hours) by implementing an automated excel database.
Helped K-12 students build fundamental programming skills in Python and Java.
Taught complex DSA computer science topics such as graphs, BFS/DFS, linked lists, recursion, fractals, and backtracking search to senior students.
Talked to people, sold carnival games, gave away prizes, and had a great time.
Rising Star Award for distinguishing myself among games attendants in communication, customer service and leadership skills.
